description: Signal board for trading bots: the Hyperliquid perp market in one table, ranked by open interest in USD (30 coins by default, up to 60, or the coins you list). Per coin: mark, 1h and 24h price change, funding (hourly and annualised), open interest in USD with its 1h and 24h change, liquidations in the last hour by side with a z-score against the coin's own last 7 days, the whale net position and tilt of the top 250 Hyperliquid accounts, and flags: crowded_long (funding_ann_pct >= 30 and oi_chg_24h_pct >= 5), crowded_short (funding_ann_pct <= -10 and oi_chg_24h_pct >= 5), squeeze_risk (crowded_short and (chg_1h_pct >= 1 or liq_1h_short_usd >= 2 x liq_1h_long_usd with liq_1h_short_usd >= 50000)), liq_spike (liq_z >= 3 and liq_1h_long_usd + liq_1h_short_usd >= 50000). Poll every 1-5 minutes: one call is the whole market structure, answered from our own caches, each source named with its as_of. A source past its staleness limit answers 503 and is never billed. Costs 0.01 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).
